title: Pick Which Woman Is Hotter And We'll Guess How Many Lovers You've Had
summary: Ten instinctive choices reveal the romantic-history range your taste matches.

landing.intro: Ten choices. No overthinking. Your taste may reveal more about your romantic past than you expect.

about.body: This ten-round entertainment quiz matches your visual preferences with one of five playful romantic-history profiles. Every portrait shows a fictional adult created specifically for this quiz. Choose the woman who catches your eye first in each pair. There are no right or wrong answers, and portrait order does not correspond to a better, worse, higher or lower result. The final result comes from the pattern across all ten choices and does not determine anyone's actual sexual or relationship history.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Look at each pair of fictional adult portraits.
Choose the woman who catches your eye first.
Reveal the playful lover-count guess matched to all ten choices.

about.disclaimer: For adults and entertainment only. The result is a fictional personality-style guess, not a factual inference about sexual history, orientation or relationships.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten choices have been compared and your romantic-history guess is ready.

profile-1.title: We're Guessing 2
profile-1.copy: Your choices suggest patience, depth and a preference for attraction that builds rather than flashes. Our playful guess is a small, carefully chosen romantic history.

profile-2.title: We're Guessing 5
profile-2.copy: You seem selective without being closed off. Your taste balances warmth with intrigue, suggesting a romantic past shaped by a few memorable connections.

profile-3.title: We're Guessing 9
profile-3.copy: Your choices carry confidence and curiosity in equal measure. Our guess is that you know what attracts you and have gathered a few stories along the way.

profile-4.title: We're Guessing 16
profile-4.copy: You were drawn to presence, poise and bold individuality. That pattern matches our experienced charmer profile: selective, confident and rarely forgettable.

profile-5.title: We're Guessing 27
profile-5.copy: Your taste is instinctive, varied and impossible to reduce to one type. Our wildest profile fits someone who follows chemistry and leaves a lasting impression.
